entry.title: Development :: RE: Long lost cheat codes
entry.dc:creator: elizacommunities
entry.dc:subject: Development
entry.content:
Author: elizacommunities
Posted: Wed Nov 18, 2026 7:20 am (GMT 0)

Thanks for sharing these — the Taz-Mania one is a lovely find. A proper cheat menu hidden behind a pause-and-button sequence is exactly the sort of thing that would have been passed around by word of mouth back in the day, and having the exact steps written down makes it genuinely usable rather than just a curiosity.

The Chicago Syndicate details stood out for me too. Explaining not just the code itself but where to enter it — Training mode, Hyde Park, holding the buttons for 256 frames — and then the Valentine's Day condition for invincibility, really shows how much careful checking went into this. That context is what turns a code list into something people can actually try.

I would be keen to see Strider 2 or Chakan next, if either of those is on your list. Thanks again for taking the time to document all of this so clearly.
